text:
jordan: Heads-up — seeing garbled utf8-like output on canary model v3 for long contexts (>8k). Happens on hosted canary route /v1/generate. Can we huddle? Priority: blocky completions for customers.

maria: :eyes: saw a spike in stderr logs around 02:14 UTC. attaching a short sample inline.

jordan: sample request id: req-3f7a, output: "ï¿½�...". quick grep I ran: \n```\nkubectl logs -n inference runner-abc | grep req-3f7a\n# ... repeated decoder errors and non-utf bytes \n```\n\nlee: I'm free in 5. can someone create a bridge?

oncall-bot: Created huddle: https://meet.redwood/bridge/xyz123 — dial in: +1-555-1234 PIN 6789

emily: joining. quick question: is this only happening on quantized builds or also fp16?

sahil: I think it's on the q4 quant variants. metrics show token-drop + latency spike for canary-v3-q4 around the same time.

maria: Proposed agenda: 1) reproduce + capture traces 2) check tokenizer/encoding at runtime 3) evaluate kernel selection diffs v2->v3 4) rollback plan 5) postmortem owner. Sound good?

jordan: add 6) validate KV cache integrity on long contexts (we saw weird bytes).

lee: I'm on kernel diffs. running `git diff --name-only origin/release/v2..origin/release/v3` now to pull changed kernels.

jordan: quick repro curl for folks who want to test locally: \n```\ncurl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\n  -d '{"model":"canary-v3-q4","input":"<8k chunked context>"}'\n```\n
emily: I got a repro locally. dumping kv-cache hex: `xxd kvdump.bin | head -n 40` — shows repeated 0xff bytes around offset 0x1f2c.

sahil: possible buffer overwrite in quant decoder. I'll instrument the decode path and push a small build to the canary pool.

maria: If we need to stop traffic, I can flip routing back to canary-v2 alias for in-flight customers. thumbs?

jordan: eng leads — thumbs to rollback routing?

lee: :+1:

emily: :+1:

maria: doing the routing change now — will post change id.

oncall-bot: Routing rollback applied: canary-v2 -> active, change id r-9821

jordan: thanks. keep the call open while we trace. DM me if you lose audio.

sahil: pushed instrumented build to canary pool; tailing decoder logs: `tail -f /var/log/infer/decoder.log | grep req-3f7a` — ping when you see new entries.

emily: seeing new entries. decoder trace shows `decode_step: out_of_range check failed` at 0x7fabc with stack: `decoder.cc:142` (shortened).

maria: creating incident doc and assigning owners for RCA.

jordan: assignments: sahil (owner/RCA), lee (kernel diff analysis), emily (repro + testcases), maria (postmortem + customer comms). Target: mitigated within 2 hours, follow-up postmortem in 48 hrs.

lee: noted and updating the incident doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/incident/INC-2026-47

jordan: TY team. I'll close the huddle when we have a root cause or full rollback validated.

maria: adding a quick checklist to incident doc: capture trace, collect kvdumps, upload logs, rollback timeline, customer list for comms.

sahil: instrument suggests an index arithmetic bug in quant decode. pushing patch to feature/safe-idx and will run the repro suite.

emily: I'm running a short corpus through canary-v3-q4 to validate sample outputs after patch. posting diffs in doc shortly.

jordan: good. keep updates here. once mitigated we'll schedule a short postmortem sync.

oncall-bot: Huddle closed by jordan at 1783506121

jordan: closing thread — root cause likely quant decode index bug; assigned for RCA. will update incident doc with timeline and next steps. Thanks everyone :bow:
